summary: Resume interrupted work while honoring verified completion.
text: The previous execution was interrupted. Recheck current work and continue across unfinished authorized tasks. Stop without inventing new tasks if all agreed acceptance criteria are verified complete. Otherwise, work across available requirements even if one is blocked, and report the verified state when no further productive execution is available.

situation.trigger: The chat broke and the user wants continuation unless agreed work is already complete.
situation.purpose: Resume interrupted development but allow a genuine completed-project handoff.

intent.outcome: Resume interrupted work while honoring verified completion.

appropriate_when: The original project may have further work
The user wants work to stop if no legitimate tasks remain
not_appropriate_when: The user wants only a failure explanation
Project scope is unspecified and cannot be recovered
preconditions: Verify actual completion state before asserting that work is finished

execution.objective: Resume interrupted development but allow a genuine completed-project handoff.

guards_against: Inventing new tasks after full completion
tradeoffs: This is not a request to broaden the roadmap after the agreed scope is complete

provenance.notes: Independently normalized public-safe text from intake metadata; no personal message wording or launcher labels.
